articles.title: Shark kills woman swimming off popular beach in South Africa - CBS News
articles.description: Local media reported the woman was a regular swimmer and had been swimming with a group when the attack occurred.
articles.content:
A woman died after being mauled by a shark while swimming off a popular beach on South Africa's southeastern coast on Tuesday, witnesses and authorities said.
Fatal shark attacks are uncommon worldw… [+2012 chars]
